name: one-page-cheat-sheet
description: Generates a one-page cheat sheet (一页速查表). Markdown by default; explicit HTML requests route to content-to-zen-static-html.
known_failure_modes: topic too broad → output exceeds one page
topic too niche → hard to find real-world examples
user wants deep dive → boundary violation
HTML requested but page hand-written instead of content-to-zen-static-html
HTML conversion expands the sheet into a tutorial
